states.name: IDLE
states.description: Waiting for a bottle. All outputs OFF.

states.name: CLEANING
states.description: Cleaning pump runs until cleaningConfirmButton is accepted.

states.name: FILLING
states.description: Filling valve runs until fillingConfirmButton is accepted.

states.name: CAPPING
states.description: Capping machine runs until cappingConfirmButton is accepted.

states.name: PACKING
states.description: Packing machine runs until packingConfirmButton is accepted.

states.name: COMPLETE
states.description: Packaging completion light is ON until finishedButton confirms pickup.

actions: Completion_Light is cleared by stage-4 unified output assignment
Pump_Motor is energized by stage-4 unified output assignment in the same scan
Filling_Valve is energized by stage-4 unified output assignment in the same scan
Capping_Machine is energized by stage-4 unified output assignment in the same scan
Packing_Machine is energized by stage-4 unified output assignment in the same scan
Completion_Light is energized by stage-4 unified output assignment in the same scan

transition_rules: At most one phase transition is allowed per scan.
In COMPLETE, finishedButton reset has priority and prevents any other transition in that scan.
Confirmations are accepted only in their matching active phase; all other confirmations are ignored.
Confirmation inputs are level-sampled; a held confirmation can complete its phase on a later scan.
A bottle still present after finishedButton reset starts a new cleaning cycle only on the following idle scan, not in the same scan.

timer_plan.notes: No PT timers are required. All transitions are sensor/operator-confirmation driven. No timer reset conditions are defined.

priorities: Safety: enforce one-hot output restriction; at most one of Pump_Motor, Filling_Valve, Capping_Machine, Packing_Machine, Completion_Light may be TRUE.
Safety: only the actuator associated with the current phase may be energized; all other process outputs are forced FALSE by the final unified output assignment.
Operational: at most one phase transition per scan; phase skipping is prohibited.
Operational: confirmation buttons are accepted only in their matching active phase; confirmations outside the active phase are ignored.
Operational: finishedButton resets only the COMPLETE phase and has reset priority when phase = 5.
Operational: bottleSensor starts cleaning only from IDLE; if bottleSensor remains TRUE after a finished reset, the next cleaning cycle starts on the following scan.
Operational: confirmation inputs are level-sampled, not rising-edge-required; a held confirmation may complete its phase on a later scan.
Operational: outputs are assigned from the post-transition phase so same-scan actuation matches the required behavior.

scan_execution_order.name: edge_sampling
scan_execution_order.description: Sample all physical inputs once at the start of the scan and update optional rising-edge memories. State transitions use the sampled level values, not edge-only conditions.

scan_execution_order.name: safety_reset_priority_and_state_transitions
scan_execution_order.description: Apply reset priority and phase-specific transitions using level-sampled inputs. Enforce at most one transition per scan and ignore confirmations outside the active phase.
actions: if phase = 5 AND finishedButton_s then next_phase := 0 and skip all other transitions this scan
else if phase = 0 AND bottleSensor_s then next_phase := 1
else if phase = 1 AND cleaningConfirmButton_s then next_phase := 2
else if phase = 2 AND fillingConfirmButton_s then next_phase := 3
else if phase = 3 AND cappingConfirmButton_s then next_phase := 4
else if phase = 4 AND packingConfirmButton_s then next_phase := 5

scan_execution_order.name: unconditional_top_level_timer_FB_calls_outside_CASE_IF
scan_execution_order.description: No timer function blocks are required by this application. If timers are added later, all timer FBs must be called unconditionally here at top level outside CASE/IF state logic.

scan_execution_order.name: unified_output_assignments
scan_execution_order.description: Assign every physical output exactly once from the final phase after state transitions. This guarantees same-scan actuation and one-hot output behavior.

formal_assertions.formula: G(!(Pump_Motor & Filling_Valve) & !(Pump_Motor & Capping_Machine) & !(Pump_Motor & Packing_Machine) & !(Pump_Motor & Completion_Light) & !(Filling_Valve & Capping_Machine) & !(Filling_Valve & Packing_Machine) & !(Filling_Valve & Completion_Light) & !(Capping_Machine & Packing_Machine) & !(Capping_Machine & Completion_Light) & !(Packing_Machine & Completion_Light))

G(((phase=0 & !bottleSensor) -> (!Pump_Motor & !Filling_Valve & !Capping_Machine & !Packing_Machine & !Completion_Light & X(phase=0))) & ((phase=1 & !cleaningConfirmButton) -> (Pump_Motor & !Filling_Valve & !Capping_Machine & !Packing_Machine & !Completion_Light & X(phase=1))) & ((phase=2 & !fillingConfirmButton) -> (!Pump_Motor & Filling_Valve & !Capping_Machine & !Packing_Machine & !Completion_Light & X(phase=2))) & ((phase=3 & !cappingConfirmButton) -> (!Pump_Motor & !Filling_Valve & Capping_Machine & !Packing_Machine & !Completion_Light & X(phase=3))) & ((phase=4 & !packingConfirmButton) -> (!Pump_Motor & !Filling_Valve & !Capping_Machine & Packing_Machine & !Completion_Light & X(phase=4))) & ((phase=5 & finishedButton) -> (!Pump_Motor & !Filling_Valve & !Capping_Machine & !Packing_Machine & !Completion_Light & X(phase=0))))
